## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.19.2.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.19.2.pdf** |
| Controls and rules on one sheet, two-sided, to keep by the keyboard | **Cognitive-Terrain-Quick-Reference-0.19.2.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.19.2.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.19 build (0.19.0, 0.19.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **Clearer area of effect.** Watch Team, Prebunk and the move preview now
  ring every covered node in sand and draw a sand line along each link
  between them, pulsing gently (steady with reduced motion). No node is ever
  left outside the shape.
- **The replay shows the real crisis score.** Next to each crisis result it
  gives both sides' crisis scores (60% Decision Health, 40% the tested area);
  the health above each map is the end-of-week figure. The crisis window shows
  the crisis score, health and the tested area together.
- **Named entry points in the replay.** The debrief's two maps label the entry
  points and Top Leadership with each one's lean.
- **The side panel fits in Military words** at every text size; long labels
  shorten instead of pushing it off the screen. Areas Taken drops the repeated
  counts (they are in its tooltip).
- Crisis labels on the timeline switch to the short form whenever the full one
  would not fit its week.
- **A new look for the tutorial panel**, in the same frame as every dialog; its
  steps say "dashed sand ring" for nodes in reach.
- **Three manuals, rewritten for playing on a PC.**
  - The **Field Manual** teaches the game screen by screen: the idea, every
    part of the screen, a turn in four steps, a whole turn played out with
    pictures, the cards, crises and ten tips. It is also the in-game Guide.
  - The **Practitioner's Manual** keeps the research and the maths, adds
    every remaining rule with its exact numbers (6.10), and its campaign pages
    show the new crisis order.
  - A two-sided **Quick Reference** replaces the player aid: mouse and
    keyboard, a turn in five steps, the cards, symbols and scoring.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.19 builds.
